name: Exalted Sunborn
oracle_text:
Flying, lifelink
If one or more tokens would be created under your control, twice that many of those tokens are created instead.
Warp {1}{W} (You may cast this card from your hand for its warp cost. Exile this creature at the beginning of the next end step, then you may cast it from exile on a later turn.)
blocked_sentences: Warp {1}{W} (You may cast this card from your hand for its warp cost. Exile this creature at the beginning of the next end step, then you may cast it from exile on a later turn.)

needs.what: A residual-gate claimant for the card-level `warp` cost, so a printed "Warp {N}" line counts as implemented when the card declares `warp`. Concretely: a branch in `verify._covered` (src/automtg/cards/authoring/verify.py) alongside the existing `emerge`/`evoke`/`bestow`/`mutate` branches -- `if card.warp is not None and stripped.lower().startswith("warp "): return _declares_printed_cost(stripped[len("warp "):], card.warp)` -- strict like bestow's and mutate's claimants, so a card declaring `warp: "{1}{W}"` cannot claim a printed "Warp {3}{W}". `fidelity.unimplemented_mechanics` also needs "warp" added to its `declared` set for the instant/sorcery path, for the reason flashback and suspend were added there; warp is refused on a nonpermanent by the loader, so that half is defensive only.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The mechanic itself is NOT missing -- `warp` is in `card_level_cost_keys`, `schema.CardModel.warp` parses, `loader.compile_card` compiles it onto `CardDef.warp` (refusing X, a nonpermanent card, and a warp cost equal to the printed cost), `casting.warp_cost` offers the cast line, and `stack._place_after_resolution` supplies the rules-given exile at the next end step plus the later cast from exile. Compiling this exact card succeeds and `CardDef.warp` is `{1}{W}`. What falls short is gate 3: `verify.claimed_lines` -> `_covered` has a claimant for every other card-level alternative cost (`kicker`, `multikicker`, `strive`, `gift`, `ascend`, `emerge`, `evoke`, `bestow`, `mutate`, `additional_cost`, `cost_reduction`) but none for `warp`, and `proxy.lift_keywords` cannot consume the line because "warp" is not in `KNOWN_KEYWORDS` and the loader rejects it as one. `residual_text` on the fully-written card returns exactly 'Warp {1}{W}', so the card is rejected as half-implemented with the mechanic wholly present. `grant_warp` is the near miss and is a different sentence: it is a static on another permanent pricing cards in somebody's hand (Tannuk, Steadfast Second), so its printed line is claimed by that static's own `text` -- which is why no shipped card has ever exercised the card-level field and the hole went unnoticed.

not_blocked.why: Both are in `keywords` and already on the packet's `starting_point`.

not_blocked.sentence: If one or more tokens would be created under your control, twice that many of those tokens are created instead.
not_blocked.why: A `replace_token_creation` static with `token_multiplier: 2`, no `create_instead` and no `affects_player` (the sentence names your control, so the default seat is right). Bard, King of Dale ships this exact ability, and it compiles clean and claims its printed line here.
